en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a semi‑rural residential area transitioning into a modern housing estate. In the foreground there is dense forest and scattered detached houses with pitched roofs and gardens along curving roads. In the background stand multiple blocks of mid‑rise, rectangular apartment buildings arranged in rows, with open grass fields and some undeveloped plots between them. No text is visible on the image.
